description:
Offences reported against businesses around an address: break-ins, theft and shoplifting, robbery. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "How many break-ins near 2500 Nicollet Ave, Minneapolis?"
- "Is shoplifting a problem around this storefront?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every offence against a business; break_ins: break-ins only; theft: theft and shoplifting; robbery: robbery of a business. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: crime_near_business
title: Crime Near a Business
